ui.writeFirst.text: Write the letter first, then press Done.

ui.step.demo.text: Watch how the letter is written. The numbers show the order of the strokes.

ui.step.trace.text: Tracing {n} of {total}: follow the pale letter, start at the green dot.

ui.step.copy.text: Copy {n} of {total}: write the same letter on your own line.

ui.step.copyAided.text: Copy {n} of {total}: follow the pale letter on your own line.

ui.finished.text: Lesson finished. You went through all the steps: watch, trace and copy.

fb.start.text: Start here, at the green dot.

fb.direction.text: Follow the arrows, in the same direction.

fb.order.text: Write the strokes by number: first one, then two.

fb.extraStroke.text: This stroke is extra. Write in one movement.

fb.missingStroke.text: A stroke is missing. Look at the numbers.

fb.retrace.text: Go back down the same line, not next to it.

fb.closed.text: Close the circle: come back to where you began.

fb.size.text: Watch the lines: the letter should reach them.

fb.baseline.text: Sit the letter on the bottom line.

fb.shape.text: Write slower and copy the shape of the model.

fb.deferredMissing.text: Don't forget the {part} after the letter.

praise.process.path.text: Right start and direction, and the strokes are in order.

praise.process.start.text: You began at the right point, and it worked.

praise.process.direction.text: You followed the arrows the right way.

praise.process.order.text: The strokes are in order, just right.

praise.process.strokes.text: All the strokes are in place.

praise.process.shape.text: The shape is more exact: you watched the lines.
